why: The real failure is the `components/ui/` folder made by hand to LOOK like shadcn without ever having gone through the CLI: with no `components.json`, `npx shadcn add` does not know where to write, the aliases do not exist and the next person thinks they can update a component nobody generates. Both trees have the same `components/ui/botao.tsx`; only the `components.json` changes, so if the rule stops looking at it the fail side exits 0 and the proof accuses.
